description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateNoteButton, a specialized widget for rendering a button that facilitates the creation of a new 'Note' record within a subpanel in SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. The class includes methods to generate the HTML form for the button and to display it, conditionally based on user permissions.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateNoteButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering a 'Create Note' button in a subpanel, extending the functionality of SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButtonQuickCreate.

methods.name: _get_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form string for creating a new Note, including necessary hidden inputs with context-specific data, to be used as part of the button rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the button by checking user permissions; if permitted, calls the parent display method to generate the output.
